text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf was fired up ahead of the 
Satsuki Sho. Even at a time like this, 
however, she couldn't help but worry about 
not being consulted on student council 
matters.

She always strives to be flawless. To 
become a stronger, more dependable 
"Emperor," she heads toward the Satsuki 
Sho as her first stepping stone.
